mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals increased consumer spending and business investment, which drives higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth acceleration fails to predict positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate rise fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
